clos.title: Introduction
clos.statement: Understand basic nature and scope of economics and to differentiate micro and macroeconomics.

clos.title: Theory of Demand
clos.statement: Explain theory of demand and to measure elasticity of demand.

clos.title: Theory of Supply
clos.statement: Explain theory of supply and to measure elasticity of supply.

topics.title: Elasticity of Supply and Its Measurement

clos.title: Theory of Production and Cost
clos.statement: Analyze production function and to explain various concepts of cost.

topics.title: Long Run and Short Run Cost Curves

clos.title: Theory of Firm
clos.statement: Analyze different market structure and explain how equilibrium is determined at each market.

topics.title: Price Determination under Different Market Conditions

clos.title: Theory of Distribution
clos.statement: Know concepts of rent, wages, interest and profit and the methods of their determination.
